name: Ensemble of the Novodevichy Convent
description: Novodevichy Convent stands on the southwestern edge of Moscow, a walled compound of white-trimmed red towers and golden-domed churches beside a quiet pond. Vasily III founded it in 1524 to celebrate the capture of Smolensk, and it has changed little since the 1600s. Women of the tsar's family lived here, and its cemetery is the resting place of many notable figures.
